meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理最近改动里的 AI 味代码,并保证回归测试仍然通过
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 AI 写了不少代码,你想删掉坏味道再合并
copy.tagline_en: Clean AI-flavored code out of recent changes while keeping tests green
copy.fit_line_en: For you if AI wrote much of your code and you want the smells gone before merging

howto.what: 它会先写回归测试锁定改动文件的现有行为，再按分类清理 AI 生成的代码痕迹（明显注释、过度防御、死代码等），最后跑测试、lint、类型检查等质量门禁；验证不过就回滚或直接改。
howto.when: 当你要求「清理」「deslop」或去掉最近改动里的 AI-slop 痕迹时触发；默认处理分支相对 main 的 diff，也可传入文件列表限定范围。

say.text: 只清理 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py，行为不能变
say.note: 按传入的文件列表限定范围

say.text: 清理时把超过 250 行的模块按职责拆分
say.note: 拆成按概念命名的新模块，并重跑检查

howto.what_en: Locks behavior with regression tests first, then removes AI code smells (obvious comments, over-defensive code, dead code, etc.) from changed files, then runs tests, lint and typecheck gates. Failed verification means revert or direct edit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff against merge-base main; an explicit file list can be passed instead.

say_en.text: Clean AI slop from this branch's diff vs main; lock behavior with tests first.
say_en.note: Writes tests before cleaning, then runs quality gates.

say_en.text: Only clean src/foo.py and src/bar.py; behavior must not change.
say_en.note: Limits scope to the file list you pass.

say_en.text: Split modules over 250 lines by responsibility during the cleanup.
say_en.note: Extracts modules named after the concept they own.
